business.description: The Company is engaged in the business of manufacturing of drums and barrels.

products.name: Steel Drums and Barrels
products.note: Used for safe packaging and transportation of liquid/semi liquid/pulp/greases/powders etc.

plants.location: Survey No.260/6 &7, Bhimpore Char Rasta, Bhimpore, Daman 396 210

outlook.statement: The Company expects that upon approval and implementation of the Resolution Plan, the same will facilitate the resolution of the outstanding debts of the Company and contribute towards its revival and rehabilitation, which is expected to be beneficial to the Company and its stakeholders.

The Company believes that growing demand from chemical, agrochemical, lubricant and other industrial sectors; expansion of domestic manufacturing and industrial activity; increasing requirement for safe, durable and reliable industrial packaging; opportunities to expand the Company's customer base and geographical presence; potential growth in export markets supported by India's manufacturing competitiveness; opportunities to develop customised and value-added packaging solutions; increasing emphasis on reusable, recyclable and environmentally responsible packaging; and opportunities arising from diversification of global supply chains and the increasing adoption of a 'China+1' sourcing strategy may provide opportunities for future growth.

The Company's business may be affected by various industry and external risks, including: Volatility in steel, fuel and other input costs; Competitive intensity and pricing pressure from existing and new market participants; Substitution by alternative packaging solutions such as IBCs, flexi tanks and other bulk transportation systems in certain applications; Changes in environmental, safety and other regulatory requirements; Dependence on demand from key end-user industries; Supply-chain disruptions and availability of key raw materials; Changes in domestic and global economic conditions; and Geopolitical developments and their impact on trade, logistics and commodity prices.
Company has focused its attention towards the Private Sector clients and the other Government Departments.

auditor.name: M/s. Satya Prakash Natani
qualifications_or_emphasis: The observations and qualifications contained in the Auditors' Report for the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026, are self-explanatory and, accordingly, do not call for any further comments from the Company.

Basis for Qualified Opinion: Books of account, supporting documents, confirmations and reconciliations relating to various balances including trade receivables, investments, trade payables, borrowings, statutory dues, Property Plant & Equipment and other financial/non-financial assets and liabilities are under reconciliation/verification as part of the CIRP process. Unable to comment on consequential impact on financial statements including expected credit loss/impairment assessment, completeness and accuracy of liabilities and contingent liabilities, claims submitted before RP, going concern assumption.

Emphasis of Matter: Company admitted into CIRP under IBC vide NCLT order dated 22nd March 2024. Powers of Board suspended, management vested with Resolution Professional. Financial statements prepared by management and certified by RP. Accumulated losses of Rs. 14,803.49 Lakhs exceeded net worth as at March 31, 2026. Financial statements prepared on going concern basis as per IBC requirement.

The Company has not been regular in depositing the undisputed statutory dues, income tax, sales tax, service tax, duty of customs, duty of excise, value added tax, cess, goods and service tax and other material statutory dues, as applicable, with the appropriate authorities.
The Company has defaulted in repayment of loan to Bank of India: Principal Rs. 44,99,54,825, Interest Rs. 30,88,91,041, Total Rs. 75,88,45,866, delay more than 9 years.

The Company has not used accounting software for maintaining its books of account for the financial year ended March 31, 2026 which has a feature of recording audit trail (edit log) facility and the same has not operated throughout the year for all relevant transactions recorded in the software.
Material uncertainty regarding continuation of the Company as a going concern.
Going concern basis - company under CIRP, future prospects depend on completion of CIRP
